DC_classification: Permanent-magnet mutual attraction retained as static preload; not a 3kN oscillatory load.

normal_force_brackets.envelope: fraction × DC force × |source axial force|/peak × sin(2pi source position/pitch)
normal_force_brackets.evidence: Sensitivity only. No calibrated current-dependent normal force or measured ripple spectrum.

mass_sensitivity: Uniform density scaling to bare chassis/retained sled/retained sled+4kg payload totals; not actual discrete attachment modes or a bound over all distributions.
magnetic_stiffness_basis: Rounded500N/mm opposing-gap stiffness sensitivity above largest recorded secant over0..0.8mm per-face closures; not a certified slope bound. Applied rank-one energy-conjugate normal coupling.

harmonic_design_limits.classification: Continuous-harmonic sensitivity/design limit; no measured ripple/damping or physical rating.

basis_boundary: 40 native elastic modes on one actual C3D10 mesh. Native mechanical geometric-prestress stiffness and assembly/host/stator dynamics excluded.
airgap_boundary: Paired face closure is gauge invariant. Individual residual divides the paired budget under the original centring allocation; independent moving stator/support dynamics and as-built centring remain unverified.
stress_boundary: Accepted native global nodal extrapolated DC peak is in MODAL_RESULTS. Response stresses bound 148 declared monitor integration points, including the element incident to the actual accepted static hotspot; not a global dynamic stress/yield/fatigue qualification.
